writtenBefore: any evaluation run of either candidate (no data was scored under the original protocol)

withdrawn.reason: Calibration is already covered by an existing registered challenger, props-temperature-v2 (research/props_calibration_20261108, forward gate registered 2026-11-08), and by the learning layer. A Platt variant would duplicate them.

replacement.why: Playing time is the deferred hypothesis listed in the calibration study and is not addressed by existing features: layer 1 forecasts minutes with a 4-game half-life average of the last 10 played games, which lags role changes (promotion to starter, injury replacement, demotion). Its minutes variance term (rate^2 * sdMinutes^2) widens the distribution but does not move the mean.
replacement.rule: Let r = mean minutes of the last 3 played games and o = mean minutes of played games 4..10 (needs at least 3). If |r - o| >= 6 and all of the last 3 games are on the same side of o, expected minutes = r and sdMinutes = max(layer-1 sdMinutes, standard deviation of the last 3). Otherwise identical to props-nb-minutes-rate-v1. Fixed parameters (3 games, 6 minutes); no search.
replacement.inputs: Only minutes of earlier played games, which the live ledger already stores; no lineup, injury or same-game information.
replacement.primary: props-nb-role-minutes-v1 vs props-nb-minutes-rate-v1 on the 2026-27 holdout with the production artifact's priors and dispersion.
comparisons: B3 last-10 over share shrunk 50/50 toward 0.5
replacement.exploratory: 2025-26 (already inspected) with 2024-25 priors, reported and labelled exploratory.
replacement.verdict: Improves only if the Brier upper 95% bound vs layer 1 is below 0 on at least two of three stats on the holdout and no stat is worse (lower 95% bound above 0). Otherwise no improvement. Nothing is promoted either way.
